name: session-woy
description: Per-tab named cookie sessions for Chrome (MV3), with encrypted persistence and an optional local backend

scripts.build: npm run build -w extension && npm run build -w test-server && npm run build -w backend
scripts.test: npm test -w test-server && npm test -w extension && npm test -w backend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:e2e -w extension && npm run build -w backend && npm test -w e2e
